fact: Namibia's MTC and Botswana's BoFiNet signed a memorandum of understanding in Gaborone providing for cooperation on cross-border fibre interconnection, IP transit and wholesale capacity, including development of the Buitepos-Ngoma corridor; the document gives no signing date, so its published date is used.

BoFiNet says it signed an MoU with MTC Namibia on 17 February 2026 covering cross-border fibre interconnection, IP transit capacity exchange and IPLC services, after recently completing cross-border fibre interconnections at Mamuno-Charles Hill and Ngoma.
BoFiNet says on 17 February 2026 that it and MTC Namibia recently completed cross-border fibre interconnections at Mamuno-Charles Hill and Ngoma; the completion is dated by the statement.
